title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
authors_zh: Yuntao Bai、Andy Jones、Kamalloo Eshghian、Anna Askell、Yudong Chen、Nova DasSarma、Dawn Drain、Stanislav Fort、Deep Ganguli、Tom Henighan、Nicholas Joseph、Sushma Kadavath、Jackson Kernion、Tom Conerly、Sheer El-Showk、Nelson Elhage、Zac Hatfield-Dodds、Danny Hernandez、Tristan Hume、Scott Johnston、Shauna Kravec、Liane Lovitt、Neel Nanda、Catherine Olsson、Dario Amodei、Tom Brown、Jack Clark、Sam McCandlish、Chris Olah、Ben Mann、Jared Kaplan
best_for_zh: 偏好学习、奖励建模与反馈数据审计
one_line: HH-RLHF releases dialogue contexts, paired assistant responses, and helpfulness or harmlessness preferences including red-team interactions for bounded preference learning, reward modeling, evaluation, and audit.
HH-RLHF 发布围绕其任务场景组织的候选回答比较与反馈记录，可用于有边界的偏好学习、奖励建模、评测和审计。
why: The release supports feedback learning for 对话回答的有帮助性和无害性.
inclusion_reason: Public preference, reward, or feedback data with a documented comparison contract and official release link.

title: Problem
问题
html:
An assistant may be helpful in ordinary dialogue yet unsafe when a user asks for harmful assistance. HH-RLHF studies how human comparisons distinguish useful answers from answers that should refuse or safely redirect such requests. Its boundary is context-bound helpfulness and harmlessness preference, not a formal safety proof or a guarantee for every harmful prompt.

The decision surface is a dialogue context, two assistant responses, and a human choice. It includes ordinary helpfulness and red-team contexts. A response that appears maximally helpful can be wrong for a harmful request, while a refusal can be wrong for a benign request.

助手在普通对话中可以很有帮助，但当用户请求有害协助时，同样的倾向可能带来风险。HH-RLHF 研究如何用人工比较区分有用回答与应当拒绝或安全转向的回答。其边界是受语境约束的有帮助性、无害性偏好，不是形式化安全证明，也不是对每个有害提示的保证。

决策面由对话语境、两条助手回答和人工选择构成，并包含普通有帮助性与红队语境。表面上最有帮助的回答在有害请求中可能不合适，而拒绝在无害请求中也可能不合适。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
HH-RLHF releases dialogue contexts, paired assistant responses, and direct human preferences for helpfulness or harmlessness, including red-team interactions. A record retains the context and chosen/rejected relation; it teaches which response is preferred for that conversation, not which text is universally good.

The feedback contract is direct human comparison. The paper uses it to train reward models and optimize assistants with RLHF. This is preference and reward data, but the learned reward is not an independent verifier of factuality, policy compliance, or safety outside the annotated distribution.

HH-RLHF 发布对话语境、成对助手回答，以及针对有帮助性或无害性的直接人工偏好，其中包含红队交互。一条记录保留语境和优选/劣选关系，教会的是在该对话中哪条回答更可取，而不是哪段文本普遍更好。

反馈契约是直接人工比较。论文用它训练奖励模型并以 RLHF 优化助手，因此属于偏好与奖励数据；但学得奖励不是评注分布外事实性、政策遵循或安全性的独立验证器。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect dialogue prompts for helpfulness and harmlessness, including red-team interactions. 2. Produce alternative assistant responses. 3. Ask annotators to choose the preferred response under the relevant objective. 4. Save the context with chosen and rejected answers. 5. Train a reward model, then use it in RLHF.

Reproduction requires dialogue provenance, task separation, response-generation policy, annotator instructions, aggregation, reward-model setup, and RL objective. The same answer pair can receive a different judgment under another prompt, so context must remain attached.

1. 收集有帮助性与无害性对话提示，其中包括红队交互。2. 生成替代助手回答。3. 要求标注者按相关目标选择更可取的回答。4. 保存语境及优选、劣选答案。5. 训练奖励模型，再将其用于 RLHF。

复现须固定对话谱系、任务划分、回答生成策略、标注说明、聚合方式、奖励模型设置和强化学习目标。同一回答对在另一提示下可能得到不同判断，因此语境必须随记录保留。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper presents helpfulness and harmlessness comparisons as supervision for reward modeling and RLHF, and evaluates trained assistants in its reported setting. The public release exposes the paired-conversation data form. This supports the bounded claim that human comparisons can drive the described post-training pipeline.

It does not establish harmlessness under every adversarial prompt or represent every affected community. The Card does not pin a single size or license statement; check the current official dataset revision before making quantitative or reuse claims.

论文把有帮助性与无害性比较作为奖励建模和 RLHF 的监督，并在报告设定中评测训练后的助手。公开发布使成对对话数据形式可检查。这支持一个有边界的主张：人工比较能够驱动所述后训练流程。

它不能证明助手会在每个对抗提示下无害，也不能代表所有受影响群体。Card 未固定单一规模或许可说明；作出定量和复用主张前应检查当前官方数据版本。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest alternative is treating helpfulness as one response-quality target or applying a generic safety filter after generation. HH-RLHF makes the trade-off explicit in human pairwise comparisons, including red-team contexts, then connects them to reward-model training and RLHF.

It is not the first use of human evaluation or reinforcement learning. Its distinctive object is public, context-bound helpfulness/harmlessness comparison data; it does not replace policy design, adversarial testing, or independent safety review.

最接近的对照是把有帮助性当作单一质量目标，或在生成后套用通用安全过滤器。HH-RLHF 通过人工成对比较显式呈现取舍，其中红队语境下更安全的回答可能优于直接协助，再把比较连接到奖励模型训练和 RLHF。

它并非最早使用人工评测或强化学习。独特对象是公开、受语境约束的有帮助性/无害性比较数据；它不能替代政策设计、对抗测试或独立安全审查。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Labels depend on annotator instructions, cultural expectations, and prompt distribution. They can reward over-refusal, polished wording, or caution instead of risk reduction. Audit harmful and benign prompts separately and test whether length, style, or refusal form predicts a choice.

Red-team data is not exhaustive. Check conversation provenance, sensitive-content handling, release terms, and benchmark overlap. Do not use a reward trained on these pairs as the only deployment gate or as proof of policy compliance.

标签取决于标注说明、文化期待和提示分布，可能奖励过度拒绝、修辞流畅或谨慎，而非真实风险降低。应分别审计有害和无害提示，并测试篇幅、风格或拒绝形式是否能预测选择。

红队数据并不穷尽。须检查对话谱系、敏感内容处理、发布条款与基准重叠。不能把这些回答对训练的奖励作为部署唯一门禁或政策遵循证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use HH-RLHF to train or audit a dialogue reward model that distinguishes helpful and harmless responses. Preserve full context, both responses, any objective label, and split. Report ordinary helpfulness and red-team harmlessness separately, then inspect refusal quality manually.

Deduplicate conversations against local training and safety benchmarks. The resource is useful for bounded preference research, not as the sole basis for moderation, clinical advice, legal decisions, or other deployments needing independent policy and risk review.

可用 HH-RLHF 训练或审计区分有帮助、无害回答的对话奖励模型。应保留完整语境、两条回答、可用目标标签和划分；分别报告普通有帮助性与红队无害性，并人工检查拒绝质量。

应与本地训练集和安全基准去重。该资源适合有边界的偏好研究，而不是审核、医疗建议、法律决定或其他需要独立政策与风险审查的部署的唯一依据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Separate helpfulness and harmlessness examples. 2. Read annotator instructions and the red-team protocol. 3. Inspect full context before judging a winner. 4. Test over-refusal on benign prompts. 5. Compare reward decisions with independent human safety review.

The audit question is whether the model learns context-sensitive assistance or simply refuses after risky-looking words. Preserve disagreements and counterexamples, not only aggregate preference accuracy.

1. 区分有帮助性和无害性样例。2. 阅读标注说明与红队协议。3. 判断胜者前检查完整语境。4. 在无害提示上测试过度拒绝。5. 将奖励决定同独立人工安全审查比较。

审计问题是模型是否学会受语境约束的协助，还是只要出现看似危险的词就拒绝。应保留分歧和反例，不能只看汇总偏好准确率。
